title: Signal: Database error text disclosed in a response

check.valuePattern: You have an error in your SQL syntax|SQLSTATE\[|\bORA-\d{5}|Unclosed quotation mark after the character string|PG::SyntaxError|ERROR:\s+syntax error at or near

scope: Single response body: confirm no database driver error text is returned.
limitations: Marker text on one body: a quoted driver message in documentation or a support article can match.

observation.body: Error: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual near '' at line 1
SQLSTATE[42000]: Syntax error or access violation
ORA-00933: SQL command not properly ended

fpNotes: Pages that quote SQL errors in documentation are the common false positive.
